01 / The context

A problem worth exploring.

Saving is easy. Finding the right post months later is harder, especially when the useful idea is inside an image or a linked article.

A local search tool for saved X likes and bookmarks, with meaning-based retrieval and model-assisted ranking.

02 / Inside the project

See how it works.

03 / Decisions & evidence

Behind the experience.

Approach & boundaries

Five stages—Capture, Store, Enrich, Index, and Search—turn saved posts into searchable results. SQLite and embeddings are local; model enrichment and reranking send relevant content to API providers. Linked pages and images are fetched during enrichment.

PythonSQLitelocal embeddingsmodel APIs
